title: Advertise FOV-relative PTZ when camera geometry is configured
problem: Thingino implements FOV-relative PTZ moves but every media and PTZ configuration response advertises GenericSpace as the default, so Frigate 0.18 disables autotracking.
reproduce: Inspect the five PTZ configuration templates on the pinned thingino-onvif revision; none can emit TranslationSpaceFov as DefaultRelativePanTiltTranslationSpace, even when fov_pan and fov_tilt are configured.
acceptance: All media v1, media v2 and PTZ configuration responses select TranslationSpaceFov when both FOV dimensions are positive and preserve TranslationGenericSpace for zero, incomplete or invalid geometry.
repair: Replace the hardcoded URI with a shared template value selected from configured FOV geometry and supply it at every render call site.

selection.reason: A one-day-old hardware-owner report traces Frigate's exact gate and the server's already-implemented movement path, with no overlapping PR and immediate device access.

verification.limitations: BCL executes the selector boundary cases and verifies every configuration template and rendering call site. The real onvif_simple_server also compiles and links in Linux; the repository's separate WSD binary has an unrelated existing link failure. Firmware and Frigate were not run locally.
verification.ownerCheck: Build firmware with the patched thingino-onvif revision on the Jooan A2R-U, query GetProfiles and GetConfigurationOptions, then confirm Frigate 0.18 exposes pt-r-fov and keeps autotracking enabled through a real pan/tilt sequence.
